response.description: Application lookup for autocompletion: finds project applications by player name, nickname, numeric identifier or character name. The search starts from three characters, or immediately for a numeric query. Changes nothing.

params.input: Search string: player name or nickname, character name, or a numeric identifier
params.term: Same as input: the name the autocompletion sends the search string under
params.nochar: 1 — return only applications with no character chosen
params.obj_id: ID of the application the search is made from: limits the result to that application's project and drops the player themselves
